jobs.title: Fachreferent*in für Kommunalpolitik, Ländliche Räume und Heimat (w/m/d) in Vollzeit
jobs.reason: The role is open to a recent graduate with a research degree (Berufserfahrung only "von Vorteil"), and the analytical/writing/policy tasks match the candidate's strengths, so on paper it is broadly accessible. However, the subject matter — municipal politics, rural areas and "Heimat" — sits well outside all three interest zones, it demands strong German-domestic policy knowledge and campaign/comms work the candidate has limited exposure to, and external applicants are only considered if no internal candidate is found, all of which pull the priority down.
jobs.type: Full-time (fixed-term to end of legislative period, 39h/week)
jobs.salary: In line with TVöD/Bund, comparable to EG 13
